speech.transcript: Two ways to lock a message. Same key for both or a key pair. Each has a job. Symmetric cryptography. One secret key for encryption and decryption. Fast, so it is used for bulk data. But the key must be shared safely first. Asymmetric cryptography A public key and a private key Mathematically related Public encrypts Private decrypts for confidentiality Private signs Public verifies for authentication and non-repudiation Asymmetric is fast. Asymmetric is slower. So asymmetric distributes keys and signs. Symmetric encrypts the data. Symmetric examples. DES, a ES, blowfish, RC5, IDEA, RC4. Asymmetric examples. RSA, Elgamel, Napsack, Diffie, Helman. Diffie, Helman is key exchange only. One key or a key pair. Fast bulk data or safe key distribution. Modern systems use both.
